اقتسمت (form VIII)

# اِقْتَسَمْتَ (iqtasamta) /iq.ta.sam.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِقْتَسَمَ (iqtasama)
# اِقْتَسَمْتِ (iqtasamti) /iq.ta.sam.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِقْتَسَمَ (iqtasama)
# اِقْتَسَمَتْ (iqtasamat) /iq.ta.sa.mat/: third-perso
